about: Hand-written expectations for the intended changes from the TypeScript MSSQL adapter (src/lib/db/mssql.ts); see 'Task 12' in docs/plans/2026-09-26-rust-core-phase-2-plan.md. The recorder never writes this file; its 'scratch' block is what record mode (and tests/smoke.rs, Task 13) builds in seaquel_test, in dbo and a fx_sales schema, every object named fx…, every constraint and index named (SQL Server's generated names change per run). CREATE SCHEMA and CREATE VIEW run as they are: since Task 13 the Rust driver sends a parameterless statement that must start a batch as a plain batch (until then they ran as EXEC (N'…'), since every statement went through sp_executesql with a parameter list, where such a statement is a syntax error). Fix 1: the catalog filters are bound (@P1 table, @P2 schema) instead of passed through validateIdentifier, which rejected names with a space or ']' ('columns'/'indexes' cases). Fix 2: the DDL quote doubles ']' (the adapter's quoteIdentifier already did; its DDL quote didn't). Fix 3: the columns query joins sys.objects (type U or V) instead of sys.tables, so views have columns. Fix 4: one row per column: a column in several foreign keys takes the reference of the foreign key whose name sorts first (OUTER APPLY … TOP (1) … ORDER BY the constraint name, as the MySQL port picks the first by constraint name); the TS listed the column once per foreign key. Fix 5: sys.indexes.is_unique is a BIT, which arrives as a bool, so the TS's '=== 1' marked every index non-unique; the recorded rows' 'replaces' cases read it. Fix 6: INCLUDE columns (sys.index_columns.is_included_column = 1) are not index columns; the TS listed them first (key_ordinal 0). Fix 7: ALTER TABLE is T-SQL: a rename is EXEC sp_rename N'[s].[t].[old]', N'new', N'COLUMN' (the new name unquoted, ' doubled in both literals); an added column is ADD without COLUMN, with an explicit NULL or NOT NULL (a bare column's nullability depends on the session's ANSI_NULL_DFLT settings), in generateAddColumnSql and CREATE TABLE too (checked live: under SET ANSI_NULL_DFLT_OFF ON, the TS's bare nullable column came out NOT NULL; every fixed CREATE gives the stated nullability under both settings); a type or nullability change is one ALTER COLUMN c <type> NULL|NOT NULL (T-SQL has no TYPE/SET NOT NULL/DROP NOT NULL, and an ALTER COLUMN without NULL/NOT NULL makes the column nullable); a dropped index names its table (the original one; the full form is fix 12); a default change is one statement piece (no ';\n' inside, so splitDdlScript keeps it whole) that looks up the column's default constraint and drops it with dynamic SQL, then ADD DEFAULT <expr> FOR [c] unless the new default is empty or unsafe. EXEC() can't take a function call, so the looked-up statement is built into a variable first; the variables are numbered (@df1, @df2, …) so the whole script also runs as one batch. ADD FOREIGN KEY and CREATE INDEX are unchanged. Every ALTER output here (fixes 2, 7, 10, 12, 13) was run against real tables in rolled-back transactions: all run, except where a UNIQUE constraint or foreign key still uses the column (error 4922), which the definition can't name. Fix 8: paginate adds ORDER BY (SELECT NULL) unless the query has an ORDER BY at the top level: outside parentheses (OVER(), subqueries, CTEs), string literals ('' escaped, N'…'), [bracketed] and "quoted" names, and -- and /* */ comments; a comment between ORDER and BY still counts. Every fix 8 output parses under SET PARSEONLY ON; the replaced TS outputs don't ('Invalid usage of the option NEXT in the FETCH statement'). Fix 9: EXPLAIN runs on the held client as separate batches (simple_query): SET SHOWPLAN_XML ON, the query, SET SHOWPLAN_XML OFF (the TS sent them as one batch, which SQL Server rejects, and under SHOWPLAN_XML an sp_executesql call returns nothing, so the plain plan can't take parameters); ANALYZE runs SET STATISTICS XML ON, the query (bound, through sp_executesql, when it has parameters), SET STATISTICS XML OFF, and reads the plan from the result set whose column is 'Microsoft SQL Server 2005 XML Showplan': the second for a SELECT, the only one for DML, none for a trivial statement such as SELECT 1 (then the TS's 'No XML plan returned' node). The plan XML is parsed as convertMssqlRelOp does (parse-explain.json pins that parser on captured plans). The 'explain' cases are live: the plan reduced to nodeType, relationName, indexName and filter, plus actualRows and actualLoops with analyze (costs, estimates and times vary), with fix 11 applied; the UPDATE case executes, so run it in a transaction that is rolled back. Fix 10: SchemaColumn.type is the full type: nvarchar(100) (max_length / 2 for nchar/nvarchar), nvarchar(max), varchar(20), varbinary(max), binary(16), decimal(10,2) and numeric(18,0) (precision,scale), datetime2(3), time(0), datetimeoffset(7) (scale); other types, alias types included, stay TYPE_NAME. The table editor splits it into type and length/precision, so fix 7's ALTER COLUMN restates the real size; with the bare TYPE_NAME a nullability-only edit made nvarchar(400) an nvarchar(1) (checked live: the column shrinks when the data fits and the edit fails when it doesn't). Its 'parse-columns' replaces cases carry the fixed query's rows as their input (fix 4 shows in dbo.fx_ledger too); the 'ddl-alter' cases are definitions built the way create-table-tabs addFromTable builds them, and live the column keeps its size. Fix 11: plan relation and index names drop the brackets and un-escape ]] to ] (the TS stripBrackets only dropped the outer brackets, so fx]odd name showed as fx]]odd name). Fix 12: a dropped index may be a PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE constraint's, which DROP INDEX refuses; the definition can't tell, so the statement asks the catalog: IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.key_constraints WHERE parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[s].[t]') AND name = N'i') ALTER TABLE [s].[t] DROP CONSTRAINT [i] ELSE DROP INDEX [i] ON [s].[t]; one piece, no ';\n' inside, the original table. Fix 13: SQL Server refuses to alter or drop a column an index uses, so dropped indexes come first, before the renames and column changes (an AlterTableOptions switch: Postgres, MySQL and SQLite keep their order); and every DROP COLUMN first drops the column's default constraint, with fix 7's lookup, in the same piece, whatever the definition says about a default (the lookup is guarded by IS NOT NULL; the variables share fix 7's numbering). Fix 14: paginate drops what trails the query's last token: whitespace, semicolons and -- or /* */ comments (the TS appended after them, so a trailing ';' was a syntax error and a trailing -- comment commented the pagination out, fetching every row); a ';' or '--' inside a string literal is part of the query. Fix 15: a column whose collation isn't the database default keeps it: the columns query returns collation_name only then (CASE WHEN c.collation_name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT <> DATABASEPROPERTYEX(DB_NAME(), 'Collation') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT: both sides in one collation, so the comparison can't fail with a collation conflict), SchemaColumn carries it as 'collation', the table editor copies it into CreateTableColumn.collation, and ALTER COLUMN emits <type> COLLATE <name> NULL|NOT NULL. Without it ALTER COLUMN resets the column to the database default (checked live: Latin1_General_BIN became SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS). Task 13 added the optional field to SchemaColumn and CreateTableColumn (skipped when absent), and CREATE TABLE and ADD (generateAddColumnSql and ALTER's added columns) emit the COLLATE too, except for types without a collation (the hand-written 'fix 15: CREATE TABLE …' and 'ADD …' cases, run live by tests/smoke.rs). sql.json is superseded: its getColumnsQuery and getIndexesQuery cases are replaced by the fixed catalog queries ('sql' cases: the exact text, bound @P1 table and @P2 schema, which produced the fix 10 input rows), and its getExplainQuery cases by 'explain-batches' cases (the batches the driver runs, the query verbatim). getSchemaQuery and getSchemasQuery are unchanged. A case with 'replaces' supersedes the recorded case of that name (the parity tests assert the recorded TypeScript output differs); its 'input' is null, and the recorded case's input applies, except for fix 10, whose input holds the fixed query's rows.

setup: CREATE SCHEMA fx_sales

CREATE TABLE dbo.fx_customers (id INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_customers_pk PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED, name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, email NVARCHAR(255) NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_customers_status_df DEFAULT 'active', score DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_customers_score_df DEFAULT 0, balance MONEY NULL, created_at DATETIME2(3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_customers_created_df DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(), external_id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_customers_external_df DEFAULT NEWID(), avatar VARBINARY(MAX) NULL, is_active BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_customers_active_df DEFAULT 1, profile XML NULL, display_name AS (name + N' <' + ISNULL(email, N'') + N'>'), CONSTRAINT fx_customers_external_uq UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED (external_id))
CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX fx_customers_email_uq ON dbo.fx_customers (email) WHERE email IS NOT NULL
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX fx_customers_name_idx ON dbo.fx_customers (name, status) INCLUDE (email, score)

INSERT INTO dbo.fx_customers (name, email, status, score, balance, created_at, external_id, avatar, is_active, profile) SELECT N'Customer ' + CAST(n AS NVARCHAR(10)), CASE WHEN n % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE N'c' + CAST(n AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N'@example.com' END, CASE n % 3 WHEN 0 THEN 'active' WHEN 1 THEN 'paused' ELSE 'closed' END, n % 50, n * 1.25, DATEADD(MINUTE, n, CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATETIME2(3))), CAST(HASHBYTES('MD5', CAST(n AS VARCHAR(10))) AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER), CASE WHEN n % 10 = 0 THEN 0x00FF END, n % 2, CASE WHEN n % 100 = 0 THEN CAST(N'

' AS XML) END FROM (SELECT TOP (2000) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM sys.all_columns a CROSS JOIN sys.all_columns b) s

CREATE TABLE dbo.fx_orders (id INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_orders_pk PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_orders_customer_fk REFERENCES dbo.fx_customers (id), placed_at DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL, total DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, memo NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL)
CREATE INDEX fx_orders_customer_idx ON dbo.fx_orders (customer_id, placed_at)

INSERT INTO dbo.fx_orders (customer_id, placed_at, total, kind, memo) SELECT n % 2000 + 1, DATEADD(MINUTE, n, CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATETIME2(0))), n % 97 + 0.5, CASE n % 3 WHEN 0 THEN 'click' WHEN 1 THEN 'view' ELSE 'buy' END, CASE WHEN n % 10 = 0 THEN N'gift wrap' END FROM (SELECT TOP (20000) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM sys.all_columns a CROSS JOIN sys.all_columns b) s

CREATE TABLE dbo.fx_accounts (customer_id INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_accounts_customer_fk REFERENCES dbo.fx_customers (id), region NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, balance MONEY NULL, CONSTRAINT fx_accounts_pk PRIMARY KEY (customer_id, region))
INSERT INTO dbo.fx_accounts (customer_id, region, balance) VALUES (1, N'eu', 10), (1, N'us', 20), (2, N'eu', 30)

CREATE TABLE dbo.fx_ledger (id INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_ledger_pk PRIMARY KEY, account_id INT NOT NULL, account_region NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT fx_ledger_account_fk FOREIGN KEY (account_id, account_region) REFERENCES dbo.fx_accounts (customer_id, region), CONSTRAINT fx_ledger_customer_fk FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES dbo.fx_customers (id))

CREATE TABLE fx_sales.fx_invoices (id INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_invoices_pk PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_invoices_customer_fk REFERENCES dbo.fx_customers (id), number NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_invoices_number_uq UNIQUE, issued_on DATE NOT NULL, amount SMALLMONEY NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO fx_sales.fx_invoices (id, customer_id, number, issued_on, amount) SELECT n, n % 2000 + 1, N'INV-' + CAST(n AS NVARCHAR(10)), DATEADD(DAY, n % 365, CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)), n % 500 FROM (SELECT TOP (5000) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM sys.all_columns a CROSS JOIN sys.all_columns b) s
CREATE TABLE dbo.fx_events (id BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_events_pk PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED, occurred_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL, payload NVARCHAR(400) NULL)
CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX fx_events_occurred_cix ON dbo.fx_events (occurred_at)

INSERT INTO dbo.fx_events (id, occurred_at, payload) SELECT n, DATEADD(SECOND, n, CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATETIME2)), N'event ' + CAST(n AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM (SELECT TOP (3000) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM sys.all_columns a CROSS JOIN sys.all_columns b) s
CREATE TABLE dbo.fx_heap (id INT NOT NULL, v INT NOT NULL, label NVARCHAR(20) NULL)
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX fx_heap_v_idx ON dbo.fx_heap (v)

INSERT INTO dbo.fx_heap (id, v, label) SELECT n, n % 500, N'row ' + CAST(n AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM (SELECT TOP (5000) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM sys.all_columns a CROSS JOIN sys.all_columns b) s

CREATE TABLE dbo.[fx order items] ([order id] INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [fx order items order fk] REFERENCES dbo.fx_orders (id), [line no] INT NOT NULL, sku NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, qty INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [fx order items qty df] DEFAULT 1, CONSTRAINT [fx order items pk] PRIMARY KEY ([order id], [line no]))
CREATE INDEX [fx order items sku idx] ON dbo.[fx order items] (sku) INCLUDE (qty)

INSERT INTO dbo.[fx order items] ([order id], [line no], sku, qty) SELECT n % 20000 + 1, n / 20000 + 1, N'SKU-' + CAST(n % 40 AS NVARCHAR(10)), n % 5 + 1 FROM (SELECT TOP (3000) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM sys.all_columns a CROSS JOIN sys.all_columns b) s

CREATE TABLE dbo.[fx]]odd name] ([col]]1] INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [fx]]odd pk] PRIMARY KEY, [the value] NVARCHAR(20) NULL CONSTRAINT [fx]]odd df] DEFAULT N'it''s', [ref]]id] INT NULL CONSTRAINT [fx]]odd fk] REFERENCES dbo.fx_customers (id))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX [fx]]odd value uq] ON dbo.[fx]]odd name] ([the value])
INSERT INTO dbo.[fx]]odd name] ([col]]1], [the value], [ref]]id]) VALUES (1, N'one', 1), (2, N'two', NULL)
CREATE TABLE dbo.fx_café ([naïve] NVARCHAR(10) NULL CONSTRAINT fx_café_naïve_df DEFAULT N'é', [名前] NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, v INT NULL)
CREATE INDEX fx_café_名前_idx ON dbo.fx_café ([名前])
INSERT INTO dbo.fx_café ([naïve], [名前], v) VALUES (N'é', N'東京', 1), (N'ü', N'大阪', 2)

CREATE TABLE dbo.fx_types (id INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fx_types_pk PRIMARY KEY, c_nchar NCHAR(10) NULL, c_char CHAR(3) NULL, c_binary BINARY(16) NULL, c_varbinary VARBINARY(64) NULL, c_numeric NUMERIC(18,0) NULL, c_time TIME(0) NULL, c_dto DATETIMEOFFSET NULL, c_dt2 DATETIME2 NULL, c_nvmax NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, c_vcmax VARCHAR(MAX) NULL, c_float FLOAT NULL, c_real REAL NULL, c_date DATE NULL, c_datetime DATETIME NULL, c_smalldt SMALLDATETIME NULL, c_tinyint TINYINT NULL, c_smallmoney SMALLMONEY NULL, c_bin VARCHAR(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL, c_ncs NVARCHAR(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_CS_AS NOT NULL, c_dbdefault NVARCHAR(20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NULL)
CREATE VIEW dbo.fx_customer_names AS SELECT id, name, email FROM dbo.fx_customers
CREATE VIEW fx_sales.fx_invoice_totals AS SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total, COUNT_BIG(*) AS invoices FROM fx_sales.fx_invoices GROUP BY customer_id
UPDATE STATISTICS dbo.fx_customers WITH FULLSCAN
UPDATE STATISTICS dbo.fx_orders WITH FULLSCAN
UPDATE STATISTICS fx_sales.fx_invoices WITH FULLSCAN
UPDATE STATISTICS dbo.fx_events WITH FULLSCAN
UPDATE STATISTICS dbo.fx_heap WITH FULLSCAN
UPDATE STATISTICS dbo.[fx order items] WITH FULLSCAN
teardown: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS dbo.[fx]]odd name]
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS dbo.[fx order items]

cases.name: fix 1 + 3 + 4 + 10 + 15: the columns query (bound @P1 table, @P2 schema)
cases.output:
SELECT
  c.name AS column_name,
  CASE
    WHEN TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) IN ('nvarchar', 'nchar')
      THEN TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) + '(' + CASE WHEN c.max_length = -1 THEN 'max' ELSE CAST(c.max_length / 2 AS varchar(10)) END + ')'
    WHEN TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) IN ('varchar', 'char', 'varbinary', 'binary')
      THEN TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) + '(' + CASE WHEN c.max_length = -1 THEN 'max' ELSE CAST(c.max_length AS varchar(10)) END + ')'
    WHEN TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) IN ('decimal', 'numeric')
      THEN TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) + '(' + CAST(c.precision AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(c.scale AS varchar(10)) + ')'
    WHEN TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) IN ('datetime2', 'time', 'datetimeoffset')
      THEN TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) + '(' + CAST(c.scale AS varchar(10)) + ')'
    ELSE TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id)
  END AS data_type,
  CASE WHEN c.is_nullable = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_nullable,
  dc.definition AS column_default,
  CASE WHEN c.collation_name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT <> CAST(DATABASEPROPERTYEX(DB_NAME(), 'Collation') AS sysname) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT THEN c.collation_name END AS collation_name,
  CASE WHEN pk.column_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_primary_key,
  CASE WHEN fk.referenced_table IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_foreign_key,
  fk.referenced_schema, fk.referenced_table, fk.referenced_column
FROM sys.columns c
INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON c.object_id = o.object_id AND o.type IN ('U', 'V')
INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON o.schema_id = s.schema_id
LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON c.default_object_id = dc.object_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT ic.object_id, ic.column_id FROM sys.index_columns ic
  INNER JOIN sys.indexes i ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id
  WHERE i.is_primary_key = 1
) pk ON c.object_id = pk.object_id AND c.column_id = pk.column_id
OUTER APPLY (
  SELECT TOP (1) rs.name AS referenced_schema, rt.name AS referenced_table, rc.name AS referenced_column
  FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fkc
  INNER JOIN sys.foreign_keys f ON fkc.constraint_object_id = f.object_id
  INNER JOIN sys.tables rt ON fkc.referenced_object_id = rt.object_id
  INNER JOIN sys.schemas rs ON rt.schema_id = rs.schema_id
  INNER JOIN sys.columns rc ON fkc.referenced_object_id = rc.object_id AND fkc.referenced_column_id = rc.column_id
  WHERE fkc.parent_object_id = c.object_id AND fkc.parent_column_id = c.column_id
  ORDER BY f.name
) fk
WHERE o.name = @P1 AND s.name = @P2
ORDER BY c.column_id
